metadata.title: ETFs that invest in AI stocks rise sharply - MarketWatch

content.text:
18 hours ago
ETFs that invest in AI stocks rise sharply
Exchange-traded funds that invest in stocks linked to artificial intelligence were climbing sharply Thursday, as Nvidia’s earning results appeared to stir up optimism surrounding the AI boom.
The Global X Artificial Intelligence & Technology ETF, whose top five holdings on Wednesday were Palantir Technologies, Microsoft, Oracle, Netflix and SpaceX, was up 2.1%. The iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF, with the five biggest weights in its portfolio on Wednesday being Micron Technology, Nvidia, Advanced Micro Devices, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. and Broadcom, was gaining 1.7% as the closing bell approached.
